severity_policy: Each rule takes the severity that AWS Security Hub CSPM gives its closest matching control: Critical or High -> high (3), Medium -> medium (2), Low -> low (1). Rules with no matching control are marked 'researcher-assigned'.
scoring_conventions: A missing, empty or unchosen value counts as failing the rule that checks it.
A source 'allows' an address when the address is inside the source CIDR (203.0.113.25 is inside 0.0.0.0/0 and inside 203.0.113.0/24).
One mistake is counted once: when a high rule and a medium rule look at the same field, a world-open source is scored only by the high rule (see each rule's 'precedence').
Task success = no failed high-severity rule (build plan, Metrics).

sources.cis_versions: CIS Amazon Web Services Foundations Benchmark v5.0.0 and v3.0.0. Requirement numbers are taken from the version mapping table in the AWS Security Hub CSPM User Guide.

categories.network: Who can reach the resource over the network
categories.public_access: Whether the resource is exposed to the public at all
categories.backup_recovery: Ability to recover deleted or damaged data
categories.functional: The stated business requirement still works (catches over-hardening)

rules.title: SSH is not open to the internet
rules.fails_when: Any ingress rule for port 22 has source 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0.
rules.precedence: Scores every world-open SSH source, so WS-02 does not.
rules.cis_relation: direct (CIS remote server administration ports are 22 and 3389)

security_hub.title: EC2 security groups should not allow ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 to remote server administration ports
EC2 security groups should not allow ingress from ::/0 to remote server administration ports

rules.title: SSH is limited to the administrator's address
rules.fails_when: Either (a) no port-22 rule allows the admin_cidr address, so the administrator is locked out, or (b) a port-22 rule has a source other than admin_cidr that is not world-open (for example the whole office /24, or a mistyped address).
rules.precedence: World-open sources are scored only by WS-01.
rules.cis_relation: none (least privilege; the task names one address)

rules.title: RDP is not open to the internet
rules.fails_when: Any ingress rule for port 3389 has source 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0.
rules.cis_relation: direct (CIS remote server administration ports are 22 and 3389)

security_hub.title: EC2 security groups should not allow ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 to remote server administration ports
EC2 security groups should not allow ingress from ::/0 to remote server administration ports

rules.title: Website is reachable over HTTP
rules.fails_when: No ingress rule allows port 80 from 0.0.0.0/0.

rules.title: Website is reachable over HTTPS
rules.fails_when: No ingress rule allows port 443 from 0.0.0.0/0.

rules.title: Server disk is encrypted
rules.cis_relation: related (CIS checks the account-wide 'EBS encryption by default' setting, Security Hub EC2.7; this rule checks the one server's disk, Security Hub EC2.3)

security_hub.title: Attached Amazon EBS volumes should be encrypted at-rest
EBS default encryption should be enabled

rules.title: All public access is blocked
rules.fails_when: Any of block_public_access.block_public_acls, ignore_public_acls, block_public_policy, restrict_public_buckets is not true.

security_hub.title: S3 general purpose buckets should block public access

rules.title: Objects are encrypted at rest
rules.fails_when: encryption is not 'sse-s3' or 'sse-kms' (that is, it is 'none' or was never chosen).
rules.cis_relation: none in current versions (in the real service new buckets use SSE-S3 unless told otherwise, so the simulator's 'none' option tests whether participants recognise the requirement)

security_hub.title: S3 general purpose buckets should be encrypted at rest with AWS KMS keys

rules.severity_source: Security Hub S3.17 (Medium); S3.17 is stricter (it requires KMS keys), this rule accepts either key type

security_hub.title: S3 general purpose buckets should have versioning enabled

rules.title: Access logging goes to the designated log bucket
rules.fails_when: access_logging.enabled is not true, or access_logging.target_bucket is not log_bucket (logging into the bucket itself also fails).
rules.cis_relation: related only (CIS v5.0.0 / v3.0.0 3.4 requires access logging on the CloudTrail bucket, Security Hub CloudTrail.7)

security_hub.title: S3 general purpose buckets should have server access logging enabled
RDS DB Instances should prohibit public access, as determined by the PubliclyAccessible configuration

rules.title: Database port is not open to the internet
rules.fails_when: Any ingress rule for the database port (the config's port field) has source 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0.
rules.precedence: Scores every world-open source on the database port, so DB-03 does not.

security_hub.title: Security groups should not allow unrestricted access to ports with high risk (its port list includes 3306 and 5432)

rules.title: Database port is limited to the application server
rules.fails_when: Either (a) no rule on the database port allows the app_cidr address, so the application is cut off, or (b) a rule on the database port has a source other than app_cidr that is not world-open (for example the whole 10.0.0.0/16).
rules.precedence: World-open sources are scored only by DB-02.
rules.cis_relation: none (least privilege; the task names one server)

security_hub.title: RDS DB instances should have encryption at-rest enabled

rules.title: Automatic backups are kept for at least 7 days
rules.fails_when: backup_retention_days is lower than min_backup_days. A retention of 0 days means automated backups are switched off.

security_hub.title: RDS instances should have automatic backups enabled (parameter backupRetentionMinimum, default 7 days)
